chapters.titleEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The report is not like witnessing.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: War is deception.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: A Muslim is a mirror of the Muslim.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Seek help for any needs discreetly.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: الدُّنْیَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤمِنِ وَ جَنَّةُ الْکَافِرِ
hadith.english: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Modesty is entirely good.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The word of the believer is like seizing of the hand.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: لَا یَحِلُّ لِمُؤمِنٍ اَنْ یَّجُهْرَ أخَاهُ فَوقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أیَّامٍ
hadith.english: It is unlawful for a believer to sever relations with his brother for more than three days.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: He is not one of us who cheats us.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: مَا قَلَّ وَكَفَى خَيْرٌ مِمَّا كَثُرَ وَأَلْهَى
hadith.english: A little that suffices is better than an abundance that distracts.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: الرَّاجِعُ فِيْ هِبَتِهِ کَالرَّاجِعِ فِيْ قَیْئِهِ
hadith.english: Someone who takes back his gift is like someone who eats his vomit.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Affliction comes from (loose) talk.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: People are like the teeth of a comb.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Richness lies in the richness of the soul.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The felicitous person takes lessons from (the actions of) others.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: وَ إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ لَحِکْمَةً وَاِنَّ مِنَ الْبَیَانِ لَسِحْرًا
hadith.english: Indeed, in poetry there is wisdom and in eloquence there is magic.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The king’s pardon preserves the kingdom.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: A man will be with whom he loves.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: A man who knows his worth will not be ruined.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: الْیَدُ الْعُلْیَا خَیْرٌ مِّنَ الْیَدِ السُّفْلَی
hadith.english: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: لَا شَکَرَ اللهَ مَنْ لَّا یَشْکُرُ النَّاسَ
hadith.english: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Your love of something can blind and deafen (you).

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: جُبِلَتِ الْقُلُوبُ عَلی حُبَّ مَنْ اَحْسَنَ اِلَیْهَا وَ بُغْضِ مَنْ اَسَاءَ اِلَیْهَا
hadith.english: Hearts are predisposed to love someone who does them good and detest someone who does them harm.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: الْتَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ کَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ
hadith.english: One who repents from sin is like someone without sin.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: الشَّاهِدُ یَرَی مَا لَا یَرَاهُ الْغَائِبُ
hadith.english: The person who actually witnesses an (event) sees that which one who is absent does not.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: If the nobleman of a people comes to you, honour him.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: False oaths lay waste to home (lands).

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِیْدٌ
hadith.english: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Actions are through intentions.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The leader of a people is their servant.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The best of affairs is that which is balanced.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِیْ أُمَّتِیْ فِی بُکُوْرِهَا یَوْمَ الْخَمِیْسِ
hadith.english: O Allah, bless my nation in its early rising on Thursdays!

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Poverty can almost turn into disbelief.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Travelling is a portion of punishment.

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: The best of provision is God-Consciousness (taqwa).

hadith.chapterEnglish: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi
hadith.english: Meetings are under trust.
